title: ASH: Admission Control Detail
description: Drill-down into CockroachDB admission control queues from Active Session History (ASH)

options.content:
### Admission Control Detail
Drill-down into admission control queues. High admission samples indicate the cluster is throttling work due to CPU or storage pressure. Use the Application and Node filters above to narrow analysis.

panels.title: Admission Queue Activity Over Time
panels.description: Stacked area of admission queue sub-events over time. Shows which admission queues are active and when.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('second', sample_time) AS time, work_event AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM information_schema.crdb_cluster_active_session_history WHERE $__timeFilter(sample_time) AND work_event_type = 'ADMISSION' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Admission Samples by Queue
panels.description: Donut chart showing the distribution of admission samples across different queues.

targets.rawSql: SELECT work_event AS queue, count(*) AS samples FROM information_schema.crdb_cluster_active_session_history WHERE $__timeFilter(sample_time) AND work_event_type = 'ADMISSION' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY samples DESC

panels.title: Top Statements in Admission Queues
panels.description: SQL statements experiencing admission control throttling, joined with statement_statistics for query text.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(substring(ss.query, 1, 120), 'fingerprint: ' || ash.workload_id) AS query_preview, ash.app_name, ash.work_event AS admission_queue, count(*) AS samples, round(count(*) * 100.0 / NULLIF(sum(count(*)) OVER (), 0), 1) AS pct FROM information_schema.crdb_cluster_active_session_history ash LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (fingerprint_id) fingerprint_id, metadata->>'query' AS query FROM crdb_internal.statement_statistics UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT ON (fingerprint_id) fingerprint_id, metadata->>'query' AS query FROM crdb_internal.statement_activity) ss ON ash.workload_id = encode(ss.fingerprint_id, 'hex') WHERE $__timeFilter(ash.sample_time) AND ash.work_event_type = 'ADMISSION' AND ash.workload_type = 'STATEMENT' AND ('${app_filter}' = 'ALL' OR ash.app_name = '${app_filter}') AND ('${node_filter}' = 'ALL' OR ash.node_id::TEXT = '${node_filter}') GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY samples DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Admission by Application
panels.description: Horizontal bar chart showing admission queue breakdown per application.

targets.rawSql: SELECT app_name, count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event LIKE '%cpu%') AS "CPU Queue", count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event LIKE '%store%') AS "Store Queue", count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event NOT LIKE '%cpu%' AND work_event NOT LIKE '%store%') AS "Other Queue" FROM information_schema.crdb_cluster_active_session_history WHERE $__timeFilter(sample_time) AND work_event_type = 'ADMISSION' AND workload_type = 'STATEMENT' AND app_name != '' AND app_name NOT LIKE '$ %' AND ('${node_filter}' = 'ALL' OR node_id::TEXT = '${node_filter}') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Admission by Node
panels.description: Vertical stacked bar chart showing admission queue breakdown per node.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'Node ' || node_id::TEXT AS node, count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event LIKE '%cpu%') AS "CPU Queue", count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event LIKE '%store%') AS "Store Queue", count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event NOT LIKE '%cpu%' AND work_event NOT LIKE '%store%') AS "Other Queue" FROM information_schema.crdb_cluster_active_session_history WHERE $__timeFilter(sample_time) AND work_event_type = 'ADMISSION' AND ('${app_filter}' = 'ALL' OR app_name = '${app_filter}') GROUP BY node_id ORDER BY node_id

panels.title: Admission Queue Detail
panels.description: Detailed breakdown of admission queue samples by queue, application, workload type, and node.

targets.rawSql: SELECT work_event AS queue, app_name, workload_type, 'Node ' || node_id::TEXT AS node, count(*) AS samples, round(count(*) * 100.0 / NULLIF(sum(count(*)) OVER (), 0), 1) AS pct FROM information_schema.crdb_cluster_active_session_history WHERE $__timeFilter(sample_time) AND work_event_type = 'ADMISSION' AND ('${app_filter}' = 'ALL' OR app_name = '${app_filter}') AND ('${node_filter}' = 'ALL' OR node_id::TEXT = '${node_filter}') GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ORDER BY samples DESC LIMIT 30
